# GetChild <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Entities](Blitz3D-Entities)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetChild:Int32 entity:Int32, index:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | Entity handle of the parent. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Number of the child, 1 up to the number of children. |

**Returns:** The handle of the child.

## Description

Reads one of the entities attached to a parent. The index starts at 1, so loop from 1 to [CountChildren](CountChildren) to visit all of them. Only direct children are listed, not their children.
